recipe.variant: H3-Base Ref2VA int8 + Fun ControlNet-Union patch, control video prepared by an earlier stage (canny / depth / pose / HED / MLSD), 20 steps
recipe.from_template: video_minimax_h3_fun_controlnet_union with its SDPose subgraph replaced by a plain control-clip loader (its note: 'swap only the preprocessor that writes control_video')
recipe.defaults_note: 864x480x124, 20 steps, strength 1.0 over 0-100% of sampling; control clip at 24 fps, trimmed/held to 124 frames.

vram_evidence.note: same 20.97 GB build as the fl2va recipes; reference tokens 'ride along every sampling step' so expect more than t2v at the same canvas

notes: length is frames at 24 fps on the 17k+5 grid: 5, 22, ..., 107 (~4.5 s), 124 (5.17 s), 141, ..., 362 (15.1 s). The template derives it from seconds as max(5, round(s*24)) + (5 - (max(5, round(s*24)) % 17)) % 17; this recipe inlines 124.

Canvas: 768 px short edge, capped at the 768x1344 pixel area, multiples of 32. Template default 0.4 MP 16:9 = 864x480 (fast preview); 0.98 MP = 1344x768 is the official 768p and holds faces/detail; never 1.0 MP (1376x768 is above the cap).
No negative prompt, no CFG: the checkpoints are CFG-distilled and the graph uses BasicGuider. Write bans as positives.

Template notes: 'Keep guidance_scale = 1.0. Raise strength above 1 only if the control drifts' (0 turns the branch off; below 1 loosens the pose); 'A control clip longer than length is taken from the start. A shorter clip holds its last frame'; the control skip is added only to video tokens. `vae` on the Apply node is the VIDEO VAE (it encodes the control frames). Works with fl2va or ref2va weights; the template uses ref2va with all ref_* slots empty (text-to-video locked to the control); attach ref images/audio for identity or voice on top.

Inpaint path (not wired here): `mask` (1 = regenerate) plus optional `source_video`; control_video may stay empty. Other Union modes: Canny (Detect Edges node), Depth (Depth Anything 3 / MoGe), Pose (SDPose here, or SAM3D Body); HED/MLSD have no built-in preprocessor.
The template prompt ends with a 'Negative:' line; per docs.comfy.org a negative line has no subtractive effect and 'registers text as content' — rewrite bans as positives.

control_video here is a clip already pre-processed by an earlier stage (canny / depth / pose / HED / MLSD frames); the template's SDPose subgraph is removed, per its note 'swap only the preprocessor that writes control_video'.

inputs.prompt:
Scene: Hyperreal desert-storm aesthetic. A humanoid figure made of packed sand dances in a barren wasteland, each move shedding dust, the wind eroding and reshaping its body.
[0s-2s] Pale desert, a sand humanoid begins to move from stillness, surface grains trickling off and dragging mist-like trails in the wind.
[2s-4s] Spins and arm swings keep dissolving and rebuilding its edges, raised sand columns glowing gold in hard light under a searing white sky.
[4s-5s] On the final pose, half the body has already been carried away by wind as a hanging line of sand, not yet fallen.
Camera: medium fixed shot, focus pull from sand-grain close-up to full body.
Audio: fine sand-scrape texture throughout, one distant desert wind call at 2s, no music.
Negative: no dissolve transitions / no text overlays / no human face / no camera shake
